edit.description: pinLongPaths (~L167): check `git config --local --get core.longpaths` first; skip the write when already "true". run() throws on nonzero exit — an unset key exits 1, treat that as "unset", not error. Shrink the doc comment's idempotence claim (~L164-165) — it no longer licenses a blind repeat write.
Extend the win32-lane pinLongPaths describe (~L697) per the new test below.

summary: pinLongPaths skips the config write when core.longpaths is already true, removing the steady-state redundant write

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests: win32 lane: core.longpaths already true locally + .git/config made read-only → pre-fix throws on the redundant write, post-fix succeeds by skipping
acceptance: New win32-lane test fails on pre-fix tree and passes post-fix; existing pinLongPaths idempotency test still passes; doc comment no longer claims blind idempotence
notes: Downstream incident @dtmd/flume 0.11.0 win32 (centercode-platform, job dal-migration): redundant write races an external holder of .git/config, EACCES on wave>=2. Full mechanism analysis was in .flume/inbox.md (2026-08-10 entry, now drained). Consumer's bounded-retry alternative rejected: provisioning is already serialized (Dispatcher.ts ~L1691) and one flume writer per ref holds the tip claim (cli.ts ~L1287) — retry would re-derive exclusion the engine already owns.
